描述_EN: the buckle, large and oval, has a hinged and chased pin. Germany, 15th century. the decoration is inlaid with seventeen blue stones. The other part of the trim features the ferret with the charity on it and two lion's heads holding a chain with a small ball hanging from its end. golden brass belt buckle and ferret, fitted to a red velvet belt with small gold braid. each is decorated with two flamboyant-style windows, edged with acanthus leaves joined by blue stones. the trim comprises two parts, one longer than the other and fitted with the buckle. elle is decorated with justice in the middle of an openwork frieze of foliage. on one side, the figures of faith and prudence; on the other, those of temperance and strength. the cartouche of the long piece bears an inscription in Gothic characters: georg denabach.
描述_ZN: 大的、椭圆形的扣子有一个铰链式的、凹陷的针。 德国，15世纪。 的装饰上镶嵌了17颗蓝宝石。 另一部分修饰包括上面有慈善机构的雪貂和两个狮子头拿着一条链子，链子的末端挂着一个小球。 鎏金铜扣和皮带箍，装在有小金辫的红色天鹅绒皮带上。 每一个都有两个浮夸风格的窗户，边缘是由蓝色石头连接的刺桐叶。 饰带由两部分组成，一部分比另一部分长，并配有带扣。 他在一个镂空的叶子楣中间装饰着正义。 一边是信仰和谨慎的形象；另一边是节制和力量的形象。 长条形图案上有一个哥特式字体的铭文：Georg Denabach。
